capabilities: Read EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ and TXT books inside the vault
Manage a bookshelf with covers, progress, search and reading status
Create highlights, thoughts and excerpts into Markdown or Canvas
Jump between a book passage and the note holding its excerpt
Export chapters and excerpt notes to Markdown
extras: Freemium: core reading, bookshelf and excerpting are free; a buy-once Premium unlocks playlists, excerpt timelines, activity heatmap, paragraph reading, focus timer and other tools. No built-in AI or read-aloud; PDFs can be imported to the bookshelf but not read or excerpted in the plugin.
motivation: The author wanted reading embedded in Obsidian's knowledge workflow, with excerpt and bookshelf data kept in vault files rather than locked inside a closed reading app.
problem: Reading ebooks means leaving Obsidian, and highlights stay trapped in a closed reading app instead of linking back to notes.

relations.evidence: Deck adds spaced-repetition cards, incremental-reading calendar hooks, AI actions, and license inheritance.
Weave Incremental Reading (+ this plugin for EPUB chapter resume)

summary: Ebook reader for the vault that opens EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ and TXT books and saves highlights as linked Markdown or Canvas excerpts.
